info.title: FlowGraph API
info.description:
Visual set-planning for DJs. Tracks are nodes, transitions are directed edges, and a set is a versioned path through the graph.

Every endpoint is scoped to the caller's workspace, derived from the session cookie. Clients never choose a workspace.

403.description: Authenticated, but the account has no workspace.

post.description: Creates a track in the caller's workspace. The workspace is derived from the session; it cannot be supplied by the client.

403.description: Authenticated, but the account has no workspace.

get.description: Cursor-paginated over (createdAt DESC, id DESC). Pass the previous response's `nextCursor` to fetch the following page; a null cursor means the last page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on title or artist.

403.description: Authenticated, but the account has no workspace.

404.description: No such track in the caller's workspace.

get.description: Returns 404 rather than 403 for a track in another workspace — a distinct status would confirm the row exists and turn the response code into a cross-workspace existence oracle.

get.summary: Get a graph with its nodes and transitions
get.description: One round trip for the whole canvas. Only transitions whose endpoints are both placed on this graph are returned.

post.summary: Place a track on the graph
post.description: Idempotent: re-adding a track already on the canvas returns the existing node rather than erroring. Duplicate occurrences of one track are not allowed in v1.

patch.summary: Apply a batch of node positions
patch.description: Bounded batch sent on pointer release, not per frame. `expectedVersion` is optimistic concurrency: a mismatch returns 409 so the client can reload rather than clobber another session's layout.

delete.summary: Remove a track from the graph
delete.description: Delete-from-graph, not delete-from-library — the track stays in the workspace and on any other canvas.

post.description: Directed: A→B is not automatically valid as B→A. Scored deterministically at authoring time and stored with the algorithm version that produced it.

delete.description: Soft delete — set items may still reference it historically.

get.description: Ranks the whole library by deterministic compatibility — Camelot harmonic relation, tempo window including half/double time, energy delta, and shared tags. Considers tracks the DJ has not connected yet, which is the point.
Reports whether the process is alive. Touches no dependencies on purpose — a database blip must not turn into a restart loop.
Reports whether the process can serve traffic. Checks required dependencies only; Spotify and the AI provider are optional and are deliberately excluded.

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie issued by /api/auth/sign-in/email. State-changing auth routes additionally require an Origin header from AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS (CSRF protection).
sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
